name: agent-watch
description: A little cat, gym coach or robot that tells you when Claude Code or Codex needs your attention. Zero setup.

agentWatch.approvalDelaySeconds.description: How long a tool call may sit unanswered before the agent is shown as possibly needing approval.

agentWatch.staleAfterMinutes.description: Ignore sessions with no activity for this long.

agentWatch.notifyWhenFinished.description: Also alert when an agent finishes its turn (a soft meow and a pop-up, no spoken words).

enumDescriptions: A friendly cat: meows and purrs
A gym coach: lifts weights while agents work, blows the whistle when they need you
agentWatch.buddy.description: Which character watches your agents for you.

agentWatch.speakAloud.description: Play sound alerts (meow and/or voice, see Voice setting).

agentWatch.showPopups.description: Show VS Code pop-up notifications for alerts.

enumDescriptions: The character's sound, then its voice (cat: meow, coach: whistle, robot: beeps)
Only the character's sound, no words
Normal computer voice, no sound effects
agentWatch.voice.description: How your buddy sounds when it alerts you.

agentWatch.quietWhenWatching.description: Don't play the "finished" sound when you are already looking at the VS Code window where that agent runs. Approvals and questions always make a sound.

agentWatch.quietHours.patternErrorMessage: Use HH:MM-HH:MM, e.g. 22:00-08:00, or leave empty.
agentWatch.quietHours.markdownDescription: No voice during these hours, e.g. `22:00-08:00`. Leave empty to turn off. Pop-ups and the cat still update.

agentWatch.volume.description: Volume of the meow and cat voice, 0–100.

agentWatch.userName.markdownDescription: What your buddy calls you. Leave empty to use the first name from your Git `user.name`; set to `-` to not use a name.

agentWatch.naturalVoice.markdownDescription: Use the natural-sounding voice (Piper) once installed with **Agent Watch: Install Natural Voice**. Turn off to use your system voice.
